name: Houzuki Enju
source:
The second son of the Houzuki family, the most villainous mage family in Japan.
His talent for magic is the absolute finest in the history of the Houzuki family, making him highly promising for the future.

Mages are inherently evil existences, but Enju has very little interest in good and evil.
He dedicates himself to magic simply out of a desire to unravel the mechanisms of the universe.
Because he has no interest in anything outside of magic, he is considerably naive and detached from the world.

He has an extreme sister complex and has resolved to do anything for the sake of his little sister.

And that is the very reason why he cannot escape from the Houzuki family.


[u]B.E.G.[/u]
[b]Letter and Prayer (手紙と祈り) [i]<Clever Moon>[/i][/b]

A fountain pen that grants an object the properties of a name when that name is written onto it.
For example, if you carve the word "Cat" into a piece of wood, a wooden cat is born and will begin to move around freely.
An ability well-suited for infiltration, carrying an underlying aura of betrayal and conspiracy.

[Translated from [url=https://crystalia.amusecraft.com/totsulover/index.html#Character]official website[/url]]
